text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while passing by the central 
plaza...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Fufu. There, there~ good girl.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, that tickles♪ So this is what 
getting 'headpats' feels like~!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh, you must be...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's Trainer! Fufufu, good day to 
you~♪
choice_data_list: Um... what are you up to?
Um... what are you up to?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
As you can see, it's time to pamper 
Fine-chan~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Studying, racing, official duties... When 
someone works so hard, you just have to 
give them lots of headpats~.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Thank you for your kindness, Creek-san♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
In honor of your affectionate care... here 
are some headpats in return~♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: My, oh my~?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"Right now is Fine-chan's time to be 
spoiled, so all you need to do is let 
yourself relax, okay~?"

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
You must be tired from doing all that 
paperwork just now, right? Let me give 
your hands a nice, firm massage~

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you even pay attention to things 
like that!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Still, every single one is just a 
condition to be allowed to run in this 
country, so it's no trouble at all."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"I look forward to continuing our time 
together as fellow students, Creek-san."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion took Super Creek's 
outstretched hands— meant for a massage— 
and gave them a tight, firm handshake.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Um, likewise~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even after that, Super Creek tried 
everything she could to pamper Fine 
Motion, but...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"Fine-chan looks happy, but... somehow, I 
feel like she still hasn't had enough 
pampering~."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Since we're living the academy life, you 
know~ I think it's good to just relax your 
shoulders and take it easy once in a 
while.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Wouldn't it be nice to have some time to 
let your hair down without worrying about 
anyone else?
choice_data_list: True, taking a breather is important.

True, taking a breather is important, 
isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Fufu, thank you both! But you see—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I'm already being spoiled plenty. The fact 
that my "present" is accepted is more than 
enough.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Being able to run in the races I love 
allowed me to experience so many thrills 
and excitements――

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
You know, like how delicious instant ramen 
is♪
choice_data_list:
Then let's enjoy the "here and now" to the 
absolute fullest!
Then I want to spoil you even more!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Yes. That seems to be the best way to 
pamper Fine-chan~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"Let's make lots and lo~ts of memories 
with Fine-chan, okay? ♪"

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Is there anything you'd like to do right 
now? If there's something you're curious 
about or a place you want to go, please 
tell us~♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Let's see... There are quite a few, but—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Really? Then let's check out the 
department store basement first! I heard 
they're holding a seasonal sweets fair♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Shall we get going~? Once we're done with 
that, tell me what you'd like to do next, 
okay?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, for as long as time permitted that 
day, we savored every single second of the 
"now" spent together with Fine Motion.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Today was so much fun! It's become an 
unforgettable memory."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Everyone... these are all things I could 
only experience here♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She gazed into the distance toward 
Ireland. Seeing her like that made me want 
to create as many memories together as 
possible.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's right! Let's teach them how to 
lean on others and be pampered~

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
You and Creek are so sweet, Trainer. Just 
knowing you care that much already feels 
like being pampered.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Jeez, that's just like you, you know?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Now that it's come to this, I'll pull out 
all the stops and pamper you to your 
heart's content, okay~?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Wow, I can't wait! It sounds like it'll be 
an unforgettable memory.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Because I'm sure... there are so many 
things you can only experience right here♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She gazed into the distance toward 
Ireland. Seeing her like that made me want 
to create as many memories together as 
possible.
